title: Georeferenced IEEE 30-bus spatial layer
description:
A project-authored, synthetic georeferencing and spatial benchmark layer for the IEEE 30-bus test system. The release provides GeoJSON bus locations and branch routes, stable identifiers, topology crosswalk fields, validation code, a machine-readable manifest, and documentation for reproducible method benchmarking.

It does not contain FARSITE, copied IEEE/PYPOWER/MATPOWER payloads, or uncleared third-party fuel, weather, or landscape files.
